name.ja: 30MM オプションパーツセット ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON WEAPON SET 07
name.en: 30MM Option parts set ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON WEAPON SET 07

description.ja: 『ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON』のアイテムが『30 MINUTES MISSIONS』シリーズで商品化。
description.en: "ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON " items are commercialized in the " 30 MINUTES MISSIONS" series.

description.ja: シリーズのキーコンセプト「シンプル組み立て」「カスタム遊び」のもと、特徴的な近接武装であるチェーンソーを含めた武器群をセットで商品化。
description.en: Based on the series' key concepts of "simple assembly " and " custom play," we have commercialized a set of weapons, including the characteristic close-range weapon chainsaw.

description.ja: ■装備する際に左右で形状が変わる武装は再現用のパーツがそれぞれ付属し、選択式で組み立てが可能。
description.en: • Weapons that change shape on the left and right when equipped come with parts for reproduction, and can be assembled selectively.
